theme.designMd:
# Pulse Fit (code.in.30s)
Strictly NEO-BRUTALISM: thick 3–4px solid black (or near-black) outlines on every card, button and chip.
Hard offset drop shadows only (e.g. 4px 4px 0 #111) — NO soft shadows, NO gradients, NO glows, NO blur, NO photos.
Bold chunky typography. Punchy solid color fills. Geometric icons only (no illustrations/photos).
Corners ~8px. High contrast. Fitness / workout tracker app.
## Light palette
background #FFF8E7, cards #FFFFFF, ink #111111, muted #5A5A5A,
primary lime #C8F542, accent pink #FF5C8A, blue #4D7CFE, yellow #FFE566,
outlines #111111, offset shadow #111111.
Primary CTA buttons: lime fill, black text, thick black border, hard black offset shadow.
Active nav / badges use pink or lime accents.
